name: AsiaPAC Communications
summary: Wholesale telco group (AsiaPAC; owner of iBOSS International and One Telecom, ex-ispONE); businesses and customers acquired by Vocus Communications in May 2014 (~$147k, via Ferrier Hodgson receiver), joint deal with iBOSS and One Telecom (ASIAPAC COMMUNICATIONS GROUP PTY. LTD., ACN 165 203 574).

events.details: Wholesale telecommunications group (parent of iBOSS International and One Telecom); lineage traces to ispONE group; founding year unknown.

Vocus Communications bought the businesses and customers 6-7 May 2014 (court-ordered administration Fri 2 May 2014, receiver Ferrier Hodgson; ~50,000 DSL/wholesale customers; statutory ~$147k), joint acquisition with iBOSS International and One Telecom.
